jobs.title: Hybrid Audio Engineer/Artist Development Consultant
jobs.description:
Muzik411 Studios is pleased to offer you a contracted position as an **Artist Development Consultant**, also referred to as an **ADC**, with Muzik411 Studios.

This position is being offered based on your experience, professionalism, music industry knowledge, communication skills, and potential ability to support artists, studio sessions, and the overall growth of Muzik411 Studios.

As an ADC, you will be expected to represent Muzik411 Studios with professionalism, discipline, and respect at all times. This role requires more than simply being present in the studio. You will be responsible for assisting with artist development, supporting recording sessions, helping maintain a professional studio environment, and contributing to client satisfaction and business growth.

**Position Title:** Artist Development Consultant / ADC  
**Company:** Muzik411 Studios  
**Position Type:** Contracted Position  
**Work Location:** Burbank, CA  
**Compensation:** 25\.00

**General Responsibilities**

As a contracted ADC, your responsibilities may include, but are not limited to:

* Supporting artists during recording sessions and helping create a productive studio experience.
* Assisting with artist development conversations, creative direction, and basic project planning.
* Helping clients understand available studio services, packages, and opportunities.
* Maintaining professional communication with artists, clients, engineers, and Muzik411 Studios staff.
* Ensuring all bookings are properly scheduled through the approved booking system.
* Confirming that studio sessions are reflected on the internal calendar.
* Protecting and properly handling all studio equipment, furniture, rooms, and creative assets.
* Cleaning and resetting the studio space after sessions, including any areas used by clients.
* Following all Muzik411 Studios rules, policies, procedures, and operational standards.
* Representing the studio in a way that protects the brand, reputation, and client experience.

**Professional Conduct**

You are expected to conduct yourself with maturity, respect, and consistency. Muzik411 Studios is a professional creative environment, and all ADCs are expected to treat clients, artists, staff, vendors, and studio property with care.

Unprofessional behavior, poor communication, missed sessions, unauthorized use of the studio, mishandling of equipment, theft, harassment, violence, intoxication during work responsibilities, or any conduct that damages the reputation of Muzik411 Studios may result in immediate termination of this agreement.

**Studio Equipment and Property**

All studio equipment, software, furniture, rooms, files, passwords, keys, access codes, and business materials are the property of Muzik411 Studios or its authorized partners. You are expected to use all equipment with extreme care.

Any damage caused by negligence, misuse, unauthorized use, or failure to follow studio procedures may result in financial responsibility, removal from the ADC position, or further action as allowed by law.

**Booking and Scheduling Requirements**

All client sessions, consultations, and related studio activity must be booked and confirmed through the approved Muzik411 Studios system. No ADC is permitted to accept unauthorized sessions, side deals, cash bookings, or off\-calendar appointments using Muzik411 Studios’ name, location, equipment, clients, or resources.

**Confidentiality**

During your work with Muzik411 Studios, you may be exposed to private business information, client information, unreleased music, creative ideas, financial information, marketing plans, internal documents, or other confidential material.

You agree not to share, copy, distribute, post, sell, or misuse any confidential information belonging to Muzik411 Studios, its clients, artists, partners, or staff.

**Independent Contractor Acknowledgment**

This offer is for a contracted position. Nothing in this letter should be interpreted as creating a permanent employment relationship unless separately agreed to in writing. As a contracted ADC, you may be responsible for your own taxes, insurance, licensing, transportation, and other personal business expenses, unless otherwise stated in a separate written agreement.

Pay: $25\.00 \- $27\.00 per hour

Expected hours: No less than 10\.0 per week

Benefits:

* Referral program

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Preferred Audio Engineer
jobs.description:
**Muzik411 Studios** is a professional recording studio and artist development ecosystem dedicated to helping artists create, develop, and advance their careers.

Unlike traditional studios that simply rent rooms, Muzik411 Studios provides a collaborative environment where engineers, artists, producers, and creative professionals can build long\-term relationships while growing their businesses.

We are currently accepting applications for a limited number of engineers to join our Preferred Engineer Program.

***POSITION SUMMARY***

**Position Title:** Preferred Engineer

**Classification:** Independent Contractor

**Program Type:** Membership\-Based Opportunity

**Employment Status:** Not a W\-2 Employee Position

The Preferred Engineer Program is designed for established audio engineers who already maintain an active client base and are looking for a professional studio environment to serve their clientele while gaining access to additional opportunities, referrals, networking, and business growth resources.

This opportunity is best suited for engineers who are entrepreneurial, self\-motivated, business\-minded, and capable of consistently generating their own clientele.

***NON\-NEGOTIABLE REQUIREMENTS***

Applicants must understand that the following requirements are mandatory for participation in the Preferred Engineer Program.

Failure to meet these standards may result in probationary review or removal from the program.

**REQUIRED MONTHLY CLIENT ACTIVITY**

***Minimum 25 Hours of Personal Client Bookings Per Month***

Engineers must personally generate and complete a minimum of twenty\-five (25\) booked studio hours every month through their own clientele.

Personal clientele may include:

* Existing Clients
* New Clients
* Repeat Clients
* Clients Generated Through Personal Marketing
* Clients Referred Directly To The Engineer

This requirement is non\-negotiable.

***MEMBERSHIP REQUIREMENT***

Preferred Engineers must maintain:

* Active Membership Status
* Membership Fee Current And Paid
* Compliance With All Studio Policies

Membership Fee:

**$250 Per Month**

**BOOKING COMPLIANCE REQUIREMENT**

All studio sessions must be booked and logged through the official Muzik411 Studios booking platform.

No off\-platform bookings are permitted.

Compliance Requirement:

**100% Booking Platform Usage**

**PROFESSIONAL CONDUCT REQUIREMENT**

Preferred Engineers are expected to maintain professional conduct at all times with:

* Artists
* Clients
* Guests
* Studio Staff
* Management
* Other Engineers

Unprofessional conduct may result in immediate review of program eligibility.

**EQUIPMENT RESPONSIBILITY REQUIREMENT**

Engineers are expected to handle all studio equipment with extreme care.

Engineers may be held financially responsible for damages resulting from negligence, misuse, unauthorized modifications, or failure to follow studio procedures.

***PROGRAM BENEFITS***

Preferred Engineer Membership Includes:

✓ Preferred Engineer Status

✓ Listing In The Muzik411 Studios Engineer Directory

✓ Artist Referrals (When Available)

✓ Access To Studio Booking Calendar

✓ Marketing Opportunities

✓ Networking Events

✓ Professional Development Training

✓ Discounted Studio Time

✓ Monthly Preferred Engineer Meetings

✓ Eligibility For Advancement Opportunities

**INCLUDED STUDIO ACCESS**

Included Monthly Studio Time

20 Hours Included Per Month

Additional Studio Time is $15 Per Hour

After Included Hours Have Been Exhausted

**PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES**

***Client Acquisition***

Preferred Engineers are expected to:

* Build and maintain a personal client base
* Generate new artist relationships
* Retain recurring clients
* Promote their engineering services
* Grow their monthly booked hours

***Recording Sessions***

Preferred Engineers are responsible for:

* Recording vocals and instruments
* Conducting professional sessions
* Managing session workflow
* Delivering a high\-quality artist experience
* Maintaining organized projects and files

***Client Communication***

Responsibilities include:

* Scheduling sessions
* Confirming bookings
* Following up with artists
* Managing expectations
* Building long\-term relationships

***Technical Responsibilities***

Engineers should be comfortable with:

* DAW Operation
* Recording Workflows
* Session Setup
* Signal Flow
* Gain Staging
* Microphone Techniques
* Troubleshooting Equipment
* Troubleshooting Software
* Importing And Exporting Sessions
* Session File Management

***Studio Responsibilities***

Preferred Engineers must:

* Follow all booking procedures
* Follow all studio rules
* Maintain studio cleanliness
* Protect equipment
* Report technical issues immediately
* Ensure clients follow studio policies

**MONTHLY PERFORMANCE STANDARDS**

To remain in good standing, Preferred Engineers are expected to maintain:

Minimum Personal Client Hours

25 Hours Monthly

Booking Compliance

100% Platform Compliance

Membership Status

Current And Active

Professional Conduct

Maintained At All Times

**QUALIFICATIONS**

✓ Recording Experience

✓ DAW Proficiency

✓ Troubleshooting Skills

✓ Professional Communication

✓ Reliable Transportation

✓ Ability To Work Independently

✓ Existing Client Base Or Demonstrated Ability To Build One

Preferred

✓ Commercial Studio Experience

✓ Mixing Experience

✓ Vocal Production Experience

✓ Experience Working With Independent Artists

✓ Existing Industry Relationships

**REFERRAL OPPORTUNITIES**

Preferred Engineers may receive artist referrals generated through:

* Studio Marketing Campaigns
* Website Traffic
* Social Media Promotions
* Live Events
* Artist Development Programs
* Strategic Partnerships

Referral opportunities are distributed based on:

* Availability
* Professionalism
* Reliability
* Artist Satisfaction
* Program Participation

**ADVANCEMENT OPPORTUNITIES**

Top\-performing Preferred Engineers may be considered for:

* Artist Development Consultant (ADC)
* Lead Engineer Positions
